title: Ride through snowy forest with huskies
description: Choose a musher-led passenger sled ride, meet the dogs and learn their personalities. Some operators pair the ride with dinner in a heated yurt.
teaser: Choose a musher-led passenger sled ride, meet the dogs and learn their personalities.
goodToKnow: The sled ride can be bumpy. Ask the operator about boarding, weight limits and how the ride feels before reserving.
